setRelativeGasPrice(uint32,uint256,uint2.details: the relative prices are calculated as: relativeGasPrice = (siblingGasPrice * siblingGasUSDPrice)/srcGasUSDPrice It is assumed that precision of relative gas price will be same as src native tokens So that when it is multiplied with gas limits at other contracts, we get correct values.

setSourceGasPrice(uint256,uint256,bytes).notice: update the sourceGasPrice which is to be used in various computations
